law: only a genuine ERROR forces a rebuilt v3 profile table; DEFENSIBLE/BEST_AVAILABLE stand with recorded alternatives. Result: V3 reuses the v2 profiles byte-for-byte.
sense_policy_disclosure: S7-H uses each SURFACE lemma's PRIMARY WordNet sense (bare-form/default lexical-category control; e.g. pull.v.01 for drawn/pulled, put.v.01 for lay); S7-DELTA uses these frozen CONSTRUCTION-CONTEXT senses (e.g. attract.v.01, lie.v.01). Their contrast is NOT a pure hard-vs-soft ablation unless the sense inventories are harmonized.
